content: {"diagnosis": ["Overshoot 2.2% PASS - well damped with 47.4 deg phase margin and 0.66 damping on -3.12±3.55j poles", "Settling 3.81s PASS but marginal - tail dominated by slow real pole at -0.16", "Steady-state error 6.71% FAIL - final 1.07m vs 1m ref after -1.26N disturbance at 6s", "No saturation - max |u| 5.36N well inside -10.48 to 22.88N limits, so actuator is not the limit", "Root cause is weak integral action: ki=0.75 leaves integrator pole at -0.16, too slow to reject disturbance within 4s window"], "explanation": "The response is stable and well damped, which is why overshoot is only 2.2%: phase margin 47.4 deg at 3.42 rad/s and dominant oscillatory poles -3.12pm3.55j with zeta ~0.66. That slow pole is the PI integrator fighting the plant integrator at 0 and drag pole at -0.609. With ki only 0.75, integral action is too weak to recover from the -1.26N disturbance at 6s, so at t=10s you are still at 1.07m, a 6.71% error.
